data.body_html:
Planning a marbella yacht charter weather october 2032? You're in luck. October is one of the best months for cruising the Costa del Sol: warm seas, light winds, and fewer crowds than summer. This guide gives you the data you need – sea temperature, sunshine hours, wind, and rain – plus boat recommendations from our fleet in Puerto Banús.

October 2032 Sea Temperature in Marbella

The Mediterranean off Marbella averages 22°C (71°F) in October. That's warm enough for swimming, snorkelling, and water sports without a wetsuit. The water cools slightly towards late afternoon, but midday dips are delightful. If you're chartering our Mangusta 80, the free jet ski is best used between 11 AM and 3 PM when the sea is warmest.

Sunshine and Daylight Hours

October gives you 11 hours of daylight (sunrise ~7:30 AM, sunset ~7:00 PM), with about 8 hours of direct sunshine. That's plenty for a full-day charter. Most afternoons are clear – ideal for anchoring at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Rain is rare: only 4–5 days in the month, usually as short showers. A 10 AM to 6 PM charter covers the best light.

Wind and Sea Conditions

October winds are light westerly, 5–12 knots. That means flat seas inside the bay and gentle chop outside. Perfect for all our boats – from the Dubhe (8m) to the Ferretti 94 (29m). No rough seas. No cancellations due to weather. Your licensed skipper will choose the smoothest route, whether you want to cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande.

Best Boats for October Charters

Our fleet of 8 boats in Puerto Banús suits any group size. For small groups (up to 5 guests): the Dubhe (€ price on request) or Mariah SX21 are agile and affordable. For 9–11 guests: the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 – both Tier A boats at €749/2h or €2,299/8h, including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. For up to 12 guests wanting luxury: the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4h, jet ski included) or the Azimut 58 Flybridge. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What to Pack for October

Light layers work best. T-shirt or polo, shorts or linen trousers, plus a light jumper or windbreaker for the evening return. Sunglasses, SPF 50+ sunscreen, and a hat are essential – the sun is still strong at midday. Deck shoes or barefoot is fine. No high heels on board. Bring a swimsuit and towel – you'll want to jump in.

Booking Tips for October 2032

October is still popular, especially during European half-term holidays. Book 3–4 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat. WhatsApp us for availability. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. We recommend a 10 AM to 6 PM charter for full daylight, or 2 PM to 8 PM for sunset views along the Golden Mile.
